summary: W(2,4)=35 and W(3,3)=27 in Lean (ViaLRAT.vdw_two_four, ViaLRAT.vdw_three_three): kernel lower bound, plus an upper bound from a CaDiCaL LRAT proof checked by core Lean's verified LRAT checker (LRAT.check_sound) on the CNF generated in Lean, where the CNF's satisfaction by good colourings is proved in Lean. arXiv:2610.32000 (Seonbin Kim, 22 Oct 2026, 'Polychromatic blocks and explicit lower bounds for multicolour van der Waerden numbers') VERIFIED to exist: PDF downloaded from arxiv.org and read in full. It covers r=3..6, 9<=k<=28 only (77/80 cells improve, 3 tie); nothing for k<=8 or r=2. Records table for 2<=r<=6, 3<=k<=11 rebuilt from the Wikipedia wikitext (fetched 2026-11-07), Monroe arXiv:1603.03301v7 PDF, and Kim; saved as experiments/G029/records.csv with a source per cell. Kim's values are from an unrefereed preprint [not independently verified].

Reproduced 8 published lower-bound colourings exactly (W(2,7)>3703, W(2,8)>11495, W(3,4)>292, W(3,5)>2173, W(4,4)>1048, W(4,5)>17705, W(5,4)>2254, W(6,4)>9778) with Rabung power-residue / Rabung-Lotts zipper constructions, each checked by two independent verifiers (pure Python and C; the verifiers were cross-checked exhaustively on n<=9 and on 600 random colourings). Also re-verified Heule's W(2,6) certificate (1131).

NO improvement found for W(4,4), W(5,4), W(3,5), W(2,7), W(6,4), W(3,6), W(4,5), W(2,8): exhaustive scan of the generalised power-residue/zipper family (Z_{zp}, z<=8, R<=48, moduli up to 2-4x the record modulus; ~20,000 small SAT instances, 0 SAT, ~130 timeouts left as teiku), direct SAT extend-and-repair (UNSAT within 2s for +1 with up to 300-1000 free positions at each end), tabu local search (does not even reach W(3,4)=292 from random). Kim-style palette blocks for k<=5: UNSAT for every q up to Kim's Prop. 6.1 bound (some timeouts). Rabung-Lotts 2012 records are maximal within their family at these sizes. Details in REPORT.md sections 4 and scans/.

CANDIDATE (not a claimed record; awaits makshan review and a further literature check): explicit 3-colouring of 70,357 consecutive integers with no monochromatic 7-AP, i.e. W(3,7) > 70,357, versus the published table value > 48,811 (Rabung-Lotts 2012 / Monroe 2026). Construction: Kim's Theorem 2.1 (arXiv:2610.32000) with a SAT-found 3-polychromatic block of modulus q=19 (palette S: Z_19 -> 2-subsets of {0,1,2}) times the W(2,7) Rabung colouring of length 3703. Kim's tables start at k=9 and his cubic-residue blocks do not exist for k=7, so this cell is not in his paper. Verified by three independent verifiers (C, pure Python, numpy) plus a direct check of Kim's condition (*) on the block. Certificate sha256 3f6bf830b77fa5c711c3c637717f690854cbecea8bc31c19758722ccda78d4fd. No Lean proof (kernel decide infeasible at this size; native_decide not attempted). SAT at q=47,53,65 is UNSAT; q=49,59,61 undecided at 500s.

CANDIDATE (not a claimed record; awaits makshan review): explicit 3-colouring of 494,285 consecutive integers with no monochromatic 8-AP, i.e. W(3,8) > 494,285, versus the published table value > 238,400 (Rabung-Lotts 2012 / Monroe 2026). Construction: Kim's Theorem 2.1 with a SAT-found 3-polychromatic block q=43 times the W(2,8) zipper colouring of length 11,495 (Kim's cubic-residue block for k=8 is only q=13; his tables start at k=9). Verified by the C verifier (120 s) and the numpy verifier, plus a direct check of condition (*) on the block; the pure-Python verifier is slow at this size and was still running at write-up (scans/verifypy_W3_8.log). Certificate sha256 ce42fac832c579ca0d31164853dd814342c6020b99c549c403ee309f2426ad62. No Lean proof. q=47..61 undecided at 500 s (teiku).

Lean statement `∃ c, APFree 3 7 70357 c` (G050 Defs) NOT attempted: kernel `decide` on a 70k-element witness is far beyond what G050 managed (kernel OOM at ~20k search nodes); native_decide not tried for lack of time. Suggested route: formalise Kim's Theorem 2.1 and decide only the block (q=19/43) and the base (3703/11495).

answers: K1 ANSWERED for all accessible sources, residual TEIKU: no source gives more than 48,811 / 238,400 — Rabung-Lotts EJC 19(2) P35 (2012) Table 1 (both listed as previously known; 238,400 is Rabung 1979 per Herwig et al. EJC 14 (2007) R6 Table 1, which still had 43,855 for W(3,7)), BCT arXiv:1705.09673 Fig. 1, Monroe arXiv:1603.03301v7 Table 1, Wikipedia wikitext 2026-11-11, Kim arXiv:2610.32000 (tables start at k=9, no remark on k<=8 beyond 'We do not claim any new two-colour records'), Pouly rabung-atlas32 paper source v2.0 (scope 12<=k<=28, 3-colour table from k=17), Komkov arXiv:1701.05603 (only W(r,3), W(7,4), W(6,5), W(5,6)), Green arXiv:2102.01543 / Hunter 2111.01099, 2301.06212 / Fox-Hunter 2606.02541 / Campos-Fox-Schildkraut 2608.20824 / Cao 2609.31798 / Liber 2509.07926 (all asymptotic or tiny), arXiv search listing (38 hits, 2023-2026 scanned) and Semantic Scholar 2023-2026. Recurrences computed from the exact statements: BCT Thm 2.1 + remark (primes p with p-floor(p/3)<k => p=7 for k=7,8) gives W(3,7)>7*3703=25,921 and W(3,8)>7*11495=80,465; Xu's product for r=3 reduces to (s,t)=(3,1), i.e. the Rabung/zipper cyclic colourings that give 48,811/238,400; Kim Cor 2.2 with his own cubic-residue blocks (independently rescanned, q<400, q=1 mod 3): only q=7 for k=7 and q=7,13 for k=8 => 25,921 and 149,435. None reaches 70,357 / 494,285. NOT verified: Pouly Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.23337824 (zenodo.org 403; GitHub source read instead), zbMATH (403), Xiu-Li-Liang-Xu JCTN 11 (2014) doi:10.1166/jctn.2014.3658 (paywalled; the set-colouring paper behind Thm 2.1 — low but nonzero risk), hmonroe/vdw and marijnheule/vdWaerden file listings (GitHub API blocked). Identifier correction: 1701.05603 is Komkov, BCT is 1705.09673, 2102.01543 is Green (asymptotic).

K2 ANSWERED: W3_7 file = 70,357 symbols over {0,1,2}, W3_8 file = 494,285 symbols; position x = colour of x (1-indexed; AP-freeness is shift-invariant). Wikipedia: 'smallest N such that every r-colouring of {1..N} has a monochromatic k-AP', so a good colouring of n points gives W>n; same convention in Kim ('W(r,k)>N means an explicit r-colouring of N consecutive integers'), Rabung-Lotts (certificate length (l-1)p+1, bound '> length'; Monroe Table 2: 7*34057+1=238,400), BCT, Komkov ('N+1 will be the lower bound'). records.csv uses the same convention. Base colourings re-checked with the makshan's own numpy AP checker: W2_7 (n=3703,k=7) and W2_8 (n=11495,k=8) both 0 monochromatic APs. No off-by-one.

K3 ANSWERED: Thm 2.1 read (arXiv:2610.32000 pp. 2-3). Independent check (scratchpad chk/blocks.py): the missing-colour map m(u)={0,1,2}\S(u) is 3-polychromatic on Z_19 for k=7 (all 18*19 APs with d!=0 meet all three colours) and on Z_43 for k=8, which is exactly Cor 2.2 with h=3 (equivalently condition (*) with r=3,s=2); the certificate equals S(u)[beta(t)] at every position q*t+u for both files, length q*n. The blocks are NOT cubic-residue colourings (checked), so they lie outside Kim's own family; the method generalises directly (any 3-polychromatic block x any 2-colour base; Kim Prop 6.1 caps q<=617 for k=7 and q<=1642 for k=8, far beyond the q<=70/75 scanned). Kim himself states Thm 2.1 'is not new' (BCT, Xu, Fox-Hunter Lemma 4.3 eps=0); REPORT.md says so too. Secondary to the direct verification (INDEPENDENT_CHECK.md: 0 APs in both files).

K4 ANSWERED with two corrections required: no 'proved', 'new record', 'first' anywhere; ledger entries say 'CANDIDATE (not a claimed record)'; foundations._OVERCLAIM regex matches nothing. Offenders: (1) REPORT.md S1.1 'בלוקים של שאריות קוביות לא קיימים כלל ב-k=7' and S4(4) 'אין בלוק ל-k=4,5,7' — FALSE for k=7: the trivial cubic block q=7 exists (=BCT p=7, gives 25,921); should read 'only the trivial q=7'. (2) REPORT.md line 1 and records.csv attribute 48,811 / 238,400 to 'Rabung-Lotts 2012' — that is Wikipedia's default table attribution, not the origin: 238,400 is Rabung 1979 (per Herwig et al. 2007), 48,811 predates 2012 (listed as known in Rabung-Lotts Table 1; discoverer not verified). (3) runs.jsonl 'beats_record_candidate: true' is internal and hedged — acceptable. Corrections not applied by the makshan.

K5 VERDICT (iii): apparently new improvement of the tabulated bound (x1.44 for k=7, x2.07 for k=8), obtained from a published theorem plus a NEW hypothesis (SAT-found 3-polychromatic blocks q=19, q=43) that no published recurrence supplies; not (i) in any accessible source, not (ii) since the published recurrences max out at 25,921 / 149,435. Modest and same technique as Kim => an addendum, not a paper. To reach L4 (only after a named human approves, foundation 5): (a) write to S. Kim (and Monroe / Pouly) with the two certificates + JSON palettes + a short C checker; (b) a 2-3 page arXiv math.CO note with the blocks, bases, lengths, sha256 and a public certificate repository — Wikipedia needs a citable source; (c) only then edit the Wikipedia table; (d) before (b): decide the open q values (k=7: 49,59,61; k=8: 47..61 and up to 1642) and ideally Lean: Thm 2.1 + decide on block and base (L3). Level stays L1.
